attchmntText: Orient Green Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Intimation of Press Release under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015- un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Orient Green Power Company Limited filed a press release under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015 regarding un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated total income of Rs. 233 Cr and EBITDA of Rs. 177 Cr for H1 FY27. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 106 Cr. The EBITDA margin stood at 76 percent. The company added 17.6 MW of solar capacity in Q2. Total solar capacity is now 24.6 MW. Credit ratings for material subsidiaries were upgraded.

attchmntText: Intimation on the Outcome of the Board Meeting under Regulations 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 - wrt Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and revision in timeline for commissioning of the Wind Projects executed by company subsidiaries
voiceSummary: Orient Green Power Company Limited reported un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total income was Rs. 146.57 crore for Q2 and Rs. 232.81 crore for H1. Consolidated net profit stood at Rs. 81.57 crore for Q2 and Rs. 105.51 crore for H1. The Board revised the commercial production dates for wind projects by subsidiaries Beta and Clarion. One wind turbine generator of 3.3 MW is scheduled for December 31, 2026, and the second by January 31, 2027. The Clarion 7.8 MW project is set for December 31, 2026. Commissioning remains subject to regulatory approvals. The company also fulfilled a rights issue objective by commissioning a 17.6 MW solar plant. Credit ratings for material subsidiaries were upgraded to BBB.
